featured_reviews.name: Nilofer Varvani
featured_reviews.review_text:
The experience at Eva Health Women's care was incredible.  From the moment we stepped in.. we were recieved with all smiles and really supportive staff. Initially I was very nervous but the coordinator reassured me and made sure the whole process was very easy and smooth.
All the doctors and the nurses were very gentle and kind. The whole package is very well put in place and flows through easily. The clinic is very clean, warm and peaceful.  I would definitely recommend women to consider this clinic as the number one for full health annual check ups.

featured_reviews.name: khimya kalani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I signed up for the Gold Package and had an absolutely amazing experience from start to finish! Rohini was incredibly helpful and guided me so smoothly through every step, making everything feel easy and stress-free. A very special thanks to Vanita , who was so warm, supportive, and reassuring at the clinic—she truly made all the difference.

The nurses and staff were equally wonderful—professional, caring, and always attentive, which made me feel completely comfortable throughout. The clinic itself was spotless, beautifully maintained, and had such a welcoming, calming vibe.

I couldn’t have asked for a better experience—highly, highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Harshika Jhaveri
featured_reviews.review_text: My experience at Eva diagnostics was excellent from Rohini guiding which test package I needed based on the requirements from the doctor to Vinita welcoming me and going through each tests and process with me. The lab technicians, doctors and the support staff were very kind and helpful. They patiently answered any queries I had and guided me properly. The receptionist Yamini was very nice and welcomed me with a smile, which helped in reducing my anxiety when I entered the center. You need a good supportive environment when you go for medical tests because health anxiety (especially post Covid) is usually high and having such a calm space where you don't feel rushed and people are supportive and patient with you really helps. I had that experience at Eva diagnostics and I would definitely recommend Eva diagnostics to others. Thanks a ton to everyone at Eva for making my journey smoother!

featured_reviews.name: Janki Miles
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent visit to Eva healthcare. It ticked all the boxes in terms of the diagnostic priorities for me. From the moment of arrival to departure, there was a personal touch. Vanita, at reception provided exceptional customer service and she was lovely and friendly. A real asset to the company. Through my 3-4 hours stay, I dealt with trained professionals who put me at ease even during uncomfortable tests and were knowledgeable about their subject matter. The equipment was modern and clean, the space was calm, quiet and privacy was maintained at all times. Timings were well managed so I didn’t queue for anything. A very good experience which I would be happy to recommend to friends and family. The only reason for not giving 5 stars is that I think it could do with a bit of a facelift - it’s very spacious but could brighter. Rohini also took time to take my personal feedback, which showed they take customer experience seriously. I will definitely book again.

featured_reviews.name: Pinky Wadekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an appointment for my medical test (Eva Wellness Silver) sponsored by my employer.
Visited here at 8 AM and I was greeted by very humble reception staff.
Post which I was guided to the cabins where my tests would be conducted and at every stage I was assisted by their staff members.
It was really helpful when they were explaining me the steps and information about why the particular test is being conducted.
This is a very good way to make a layman understand the benefits of such tests.
Overall am delighted and would recommend anyone who visits here to experience the treatment and support from them.

featured_reviews.name: Shruti Prashant Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
On Sunday, 18th January, I decided to visit EVA in Bangalore, part of NM Medical, located opposite Leela Palace.

From the moment I walked in, I was greeted by warm, welcoming faces who promptly confirmed my details and the tests I had opted for. There was no waiting at all—I was seamlessly guided to my blood tests. The experience was surprisingly comfortable; the lady drawing my blood kept me engaged in a pleasant conversation, frequently checking if I was okay. Thanks to her calm and caring approach, I didn’t even realise when five vials were drawn—without a moment of anxiety.

Post this, I was guided for my sonography (abdomen and pelvic area) and mammography. The doctor was extremely gentle, patient, and explained things clearly, which instantly put me at ease.

Once the tests were done, I was escorted to a beautifully set-up breakfast area within the lab. Never before have I experienced a healthy, thoughtfully curated breakfast at a diagnostic centre. This was also when I had a conversation with the Head of the Centre, who genuinely wanted to understand how my experience had been so far.

The final test was the mammogram—something I had always been apprehensive about. However, my experience at EVA completely changed that perception. The technician was exceptionally gentle, constantly checking on my comfort and ensuring there was no distress. That long-standing fear is now truly gone.

Overall, it was a wonderful, seamless experience—completely unlike the usual diagnostic centres where waiting, confusion, and follow-ups are the norm. EVA has truly redefined what a healthcare experience can feel like.

featured_reviews.name: HB
featured_reviews.review_text: As an NRI, living in a country that doesn't provide any preventive care or diagnostics, coming to NM Eva has been a great find. Their services are top notch, and their tests are very comprehensive. Right from full profile blood tests, to ECGs and Ultrasounds, to Bone density and fat analysis (both crucial for women), this place is a one stop shop for all diagnostic women care. What's even better is their impeccable service and hygiene, economical packages, and the safety of being an all women centre makes this a great choice for women looking for diagnostic care. Their centre is stress free and a far cry from the stress and chaos of hospitals. 100% recommended, especially if you live outside India and are unable to find medical professionals who are interested in your preventive care woes. Thank you Rohini and Vanita and all the lovely staff their for their attention and care.

featured_reviews.name: Pradnya Parulkar
featured_reviews.review_text:

The experience was simply wonderful and didn’t stress me out at all.
The reception team had Vanita who was very helpful and explained everything.
There was no waiting for any test .
The breakfast was really delicious.All the consultants were very friendly and did a great job .Rohini is the person in charge and is full of enthusiasm and makes you feel welcome.Would definitely recommend this experience

featured_reviews.name: L Costa
featured_reviews.review_text:
First fail is the way they draw blood, they poke at at 45 degree angle and try to adjust the depth until blood comes out, causing pain and bleeding for days, they also leave it dangling so that the tip of the needle pokes and scratches my veins internally whenever they move and change vacuum tubes. They don’t stabilise despite telling them and just carry on.

As for the injection dyes prior to CT angio, they push it in so fast I felt my entire veins were about to explode in excruciating pain , I’ve done angios before these guys just are careless, and my entire forearm veins were painful for a whole week couldn’t even sleep properly, whenever I raised the concern they again just sway their head and say it’s ok it will subside…. Everything is met with “it’s ok don’t worry”

Their hygiene standards aren’t great I had to tell them to change cover paper sheets everytime they don’t even do that, and sometimes their rooms don’t even have cover sheets you can see how gunky and dirty it is, even that is met with “it’s ok it has been cleaned” despite it being visibly unclean. I developed boils on the back of my scalp after visiting them

As for the MRI I went in and not only was the tray not clean they didn’t even have new paper to place on the tray they had to make me wait ages to get new paper so I can lie down on it, but it doesn’t matter anyway because they give neck stabilisers that appear oily and unclean and smell of people oils , then when you go into the MRI machine you can see spit , dried up yellow / green phlegm of previous patients about 8 cm from my face and had to sit still for 30 mins of that because they can stop once started. It is clear this had not been cleaned in a while given how baked in and dried up it was inside the MRI machine.

Then you have to keep chasing for weeks for their reports and anomalies in their report , for example they list the pre fasting sugar as higher than after eating something ?? They say I have no allergy to shellfish when it can send me to hospital on anaphylaxis, they say I am highly allergic to dairy and gluten when dairy and bread is a staple diet in my daily life with zero issues ?

Their genomic report says I have low chances of high cholesterol yet I have very high cholesterol despite being in shape ?

They must be like a meat factory processing things anyhow , with no basic care on hygiene, basic techniques of blood drawing and injections, and their lab results despite complaints they double down on the most basic, like the allergy reports.

I spent 86k but honestly got pain, frustration, boils at the back of my head , and rubbish reports that my GP back home laughed at shaking his head.

These guys would have been shut down in no time if they operated overseas in any western country.

India may have great doctors but this meat factory doesn’t seem to have those given the lack or accountability and volume focus.

To potential clients: this is feedback to beware of
To NM Medical: please treat this as urgent feedback to think of seriously improving upon. It is apparent most large concerns in India have a flow of magical 5 star reviews because India has more than just talented doctors. But at the end of the day you are the land of karma and hopefully you want to go back home knowing you do a good job for the overall good of everyone and not just finances of shareholders and management 🙏

featured_reviews.name: Vijay Thakkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
NM Medical at Marine Lines offers a comprehensive range of diagnostic services, including pathology, imaging, and preventive health check-ups, equipped with modern technology such as 3D Digital Mammography with Tomosynthesis, EKG, DEXA, Ultrasound, CT scans, and MRI.

You can get a wide variety of tests available under one roof. The staff is very helpful and the facility is clean. The restrooms are very well maintained and lounges are comfortable. The janitors do an excellent job. The stool and Urine sample collection is also very convenient. Once your lab work is done you can request chai (free). They also have lockers available to store your valuables.

Their vision clinic doctor is 10/10 and so do ladies handling the pathology lab. Absolutely awesome.

The reports are sent via link in text/email and most are available the same day. You will also get printed copies of the report. You can have them deliver physical medical reports to your doctor for a charge. The reports are very well organized, easy to understand and printed on good quality paper in color.

Coordinating with the facility via WhatsApp is also very convenient.

I was give anesthesia (conscious sedation) for MRI due to me being claustrophobic and was charged INR 4000 cash only which I found shady considering I paid 1.25 lakhs via credit card. I was refused bill for INR 4000. Also, the facility misplaced doctor’s letter requesting lab work which happened to include my prescriptions and letter of admission for hospital. I think they a better job managing checkin, checkout and ensuring patient documents aren’t misplaced.

One must note that there’s absolutely no cell phone network at the facility. I have Airtel, Jio and Vi SIM cards and none had network. The Wi-Fi wasn’t available during my visit. And, I think due to network limitations their credit card machines keep failing to connect with the payment processing network. It took me 1.5 hours to make the payment of 1.25 lakhs, which is absolutely insane. A lot of people were pissed during my visit but front desk showed no signs of empathy.

Overall, a good facility but some improvements in billing transparency, organization, checkin, checkout and customer service are needed.

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: SAIF BIN SAFWAN
featured_reviews.review_text:
Lack of Transparency – Be Very Careful

I booked a blood test with NM Medical. They came to my hotel to collect the sample, which was convenient. I clearly told them what specific tests I wanted. But when I went to follow up, they told me it was a “package” – with no details provided in advance.

They never informed me what was included in the package, and the word “Package” was written with no breakdown of the tests. They charged me ₹19,900 for something I could have done outside for less than ₹7,000.

I emailed them and got a call with promises of action, but till now, no proper explanation or refund has been given.

My advice: if you’re planning to use NM Medical, get everything in writing and clarify all prices and details in advance.
Otherwise, you might end up paying a high price for unclear services. Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this center based on my experience.

featured_reviews.name: Aparna Damani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently underwent my annual full-body check-up at N M Medical at Marine Lines, and I was thoroughly impressed. The entire process was smooth and stress-free, thanks to the very friendly and well-organized staff. The facility was immaculate and created a welcoming atmosphere that instantly put me at ease.

The medical team ensured I felt informed and comfortable throughout my visit. I was especially impressed with the efficiency of the follow-up process—reports were sent via text and email on the same day, which greatly enhanced the overall experience.

A special note of appreciation goes to Tarun, whose exceptional service truly stood out. His warm personality, professionalism, and genuine care made a significant difference, ensuring that I felt valued and reassured.

I would highly recommend to anyone seeking top-quality healthcare in a clean, professional, and efficient environment!

HbA1c Test: Purpose, Procedure, Normal Range & Results
May 26, 2026 - By Lupin Diagnostics
India has over 10.1 crore people living with diabetes. A daily finger-prick reading captures just one moment. The HbA1c test normal range tells a fuller story. This simple blood test reveals your average blood sugar over three months. Here is everything you need to know about it.
What Is the HbA1c Test and How Does It Work?
Glucose in your blood naturally sticks to haemoglobin, the protein inside red blood cells. The more sugar in your blood, the more gets attached. Since red blood cells live for roughly three months, the HbA1c test captures your average blood sugar level over that entire period.
This makes it far more reliable than a single fasting reading. A fasting test changes with your last meal or stress levels. Glycated haemoglobin, on the other hand, reflects steady patterns. Think of it as a three-month report card for your blood sugar.
Here is how it differs from routine glucose checks:
A fasting blood sugar test measures glucose at one point in time.
The HbA1c test shows a percentage reflecting 90-day glucose control.
It does not swing based on a recent meal or exercise session.
